purpose: Minimum provenance contract for production infrastructure records so project screening can distinguish a nearby asset from usable, supportable service capacity.
rules: A nearby utility asset is not evidence of serviceability by itself.
Usable headroom must be distinguishable from nameplate or system-wide capacity.
Observation time and retrieval time are separate fields.
Modeled lead time must not be presented as a utility commitment.
Written utility or infrastructure evidence supersedes prototype assumptions for the same field.
A rejected or contradictory source must remain in the audit trail rather than being silently deleted.
Production rankings must expose the weakest dependency and any evidence discount applied to it.
